players.product: Custom data-center AI silicon (new entrant; hyperscaler custom-ASIC engagement)

quarterly_data.signal: HIGH BANDWIDTH COMPUTE MOVES FROM THE DATA CENTER TO THE SMARTPHONE. CEO Cristiano Amon: HBC, the engine that 'connects memory and the accelerator' introduced with Qualcomm's data-center entry, 'is now scaled all the way into the smartphone' - 'we developed HBC for Snapdragon as a co-processor to Snapdragon that is going to bring memory and AI processing closer together'. He expects it in laptops, smart glasses and cars as well, and said the HBC-for-Snapdragon announcement will come at Mobile World Congress. Rationale: future agentic AI devices 'may process up to 1 million tokens per day on device'.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 1 million tokens per day on device (future agentic devices)

quarterly_data.signal: Flagship mobile launch: Qualcomm introduced two Snapdragon 8 Elite platforms, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 (Chris Patrick). New Oryon CPU with 8 cores (two prime, six performance), which Qualcomm calls the first mobile CPU to break the 5 gigahertz barrier; dual micro NPU with 85% more performance at 20% less power; Hexagon NPU shared memory increased by 50%, up to 80% faster prefill on select models and context windows up to 32K tokens; 30 billion parameter Mixture of Experts models run on-device from flash storage with UFS 5.0. Product manager Lekha: Adreno GPU 44% performance improvement and 40% power efficiency, X105 5G Modem-RF with a new 6-nanometer RF, FastConnect 8800 for Wi-Fi 8, and a new Offset Package-on-Package thermal design giving more than 2 times longer peak performance.
quarterly_data.figure: 5 gigahertz CPU; NPU shared memory increased by 50%; up to 80% faster prefill; GPU 44% performance improvement; 30 billion parameter models on-device

quarterly_data.signal: Sergio Buniac, new Group GM of Mobile Computing and XR (former Motorola Devices CEO), on the agentic-device opportunity: 'we are moving from hundreds of millions of Snapdragon devices to probably billions in a very short term'.
